_why: Per-chunk gzipped budgets, checked by scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs after a build. Lighthouse audits pages and cannot reach a route behind Keycloak, which is every route in this application except /login; this reaches every chunk. Numbers are what each chunk measured when the budget was added, plus 2% rounded up - enough that an ordinary edit does not fail the build, not enough to absorb a new dependency. Never raise one to make a build pass.

_notes.exceljs.min.js: MUI X Premium's Excel export, a direct dependency of @mui/x-data-grid-premium. Lazy - nobody fetches it unless they export - but it is 23% of everything this application ships. It leaves entirely on DataGridPro, which is worth measuring against what Premium features the grids actually use.
_notes.lodash.js: 26 KB for isEmpty in four files and capitalize in one. Scheduled for removal; the budget is here so it cannot grow while it waits.
_notes.rasterizeHTML.js: Pulled in by the grid's print export. Not obviously load-bearing - worth checking whether print is reachable at all.
_notes.totalBytes: 1216 KB measured on MUI 9.4.0 / MUI X 9.13.0. The previous baseline was 1211 KB on 9.3.1 / 9.12.0 - the bump cost 5 KB gzipped, and these numbers were re-derived as part of it rather than raised later under pressure. symposia-ui holds 900 KB, which is the number to aim at rather than to declare: this app ships MUI X Premium's grid, charts and pickers where Symposia ships one grid.
